entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6258364939144564992: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.7035 +/- 0.0268 mas (same row, RUWE 0.94): 149.18 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -54.792, -44.290 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.552 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-318 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.499.5416C/abstract). Mass 0.561 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-318 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.499.5416C/abstract). Temperature 3851 +/- 83 K from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-318 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,851 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffd09e. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,851 K and log g 4.7 (u1 0.454, u2 0.300): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
